capabilities.name: PolicyScna Capability Control Plane
capabilities.responsibility: Govern stable capability identity, semantic ownership, lifecycle and reuse policy, then reconcile those claims continuously against repository-derived structure.
capabilities.authority_role: Repository architecture-memory integrity control; it does not decide insurance truth or runtime answer content.
safety_invariants: Derivable repository facts are verified from the tree rather than trusted as parallel catalog data.
NEW capability classification is never inferred merely from absence of an exact vocabulary match.
The catalog remains descriptive and must not carry roadmap or next-action authority.
Strict unregistered-capability enforcement may be enabled only after the governed census is reconciled.
The control plane is subject to its own scanner and validation rules.
capabilities.notes: Initial self-registration. Repository-wide census is intentionally incomplete while enforcement_mode remains RECONCILIATION.
